Featured Manager · GW10

Second on Points, Ninth in the Model

willmoran has the second-best record and the second-most points in the league, and a roster the model does not believe in

Nine weeks in, he is 6-3 and only the leader has outscored him. He has done it without a signature week. This gameweek's 104.70 was the second biggest score in the league and the first time all season he has finished a week in the top three; six of his nine have landed between fourth and sixth. Nobody has been that steady. Both of the sides above him have had a week in the bottom four, and he has only had two.

The roster that is doing it is not the one he drafted. Three of his first four picks are nowhere near his six best scorers, and his best player by a distance is Groß, taken in the sixth round. This week his three highest starters were all waiver pickups, with Rudoni leading, while his first round pick contributed four points. The side has been rebuilt on the fly and it has not cost him a beat.

The model is unmoved. It rates his roster ninth of twelve on strength and gives him a title chance a shade over one in thirty, behind five managers below him in the table. The all-play record says otherwise: scored against the whole field every week he is 58-40, third best in the league. One of the two is going to be wrong about him, and the next few weeks will say which.
